title: Combining Clinical-Radiomics Features With Machine Learning Methods for Building Models to Predict Postoperative Recurrence in Patients With Chronic Subdural Hematoma: Retrospective Cohort Study
summary: Clinical and radiomic features with machine learning predicted postoperative recurrence of chronic subdural hematoma; the retrospective cohort and reported validation support a bounded clinical prediction claim.
ai_technology: Machine-learning recurrence-risk model using clinical and radiomic features
